findings.title: Derivation records the input profile digest but rewrites the bundled profile bytes
findings.counterexample: Compact serialization of profiles/qore.json was derived into /tmp/qore-independent-verifier-51y5w0tg/derived. Derive and verify exit 0. Manifest profile.sha256 is 63c9157e3dd4d6eb2c33c899820422e8ce1d1bee9cc4e22c1df96d814e50a83f; actual bundled profile and runtime checker identity are da03026c9f73a7771cc35aaaff898a3b970fed75362ebfd0c670068d6b23b3d9. Expected one unambiguous consumed-profile identity, or distinct source/bundled identity fields. Parsed content is equal, so this demonstrates byte-identity/provenance inconsistency rather than changed facts.

findings.title: Unchanged failing gates bypass the promised three-comparison plateau stop
findings.evidence: skills/qore-ux-review/scripts/stop-rule.mjs:84-85; skills/qore-ux-review/references/protocol.md Stop and report; verifier-results.json plateau and nonfailure-plateau.
findings.counterexample: Four measured iterations n=1..4 each have G1=3. Actual exit 0 decision CHANGE_APPROACH with stuck_count=3 and no_improve_count=3. Expected STOP_PLATEAU after three comparisons without improvement per protocol. Control with four missing-measurement iterations reaches STOP_PLATEAU, demonstrating that unchanged failures mask the plateau branch. Six-iteration ceiling still applies.

findings.title: Spec validation counts literal docstring text as executable acceptance steps
findings.counterexample: Generated /tmp/qore-independent-verifier-51y5w0tg/docstring.md has one actual Given step; the only When and Then occur inside its triple-quoted literal argument. Actual spec-lint exits 0 valid:true with no problems. Expected rejection for missing executable When and Then. Replacing those literal words with LiteralWhen/LiteralThen makes it reject both missing steps. Separately an Outline with <message> and no Examples also passes despite the explicit populated-Examples requirement.

findings.title: Inherited object properties can satisfy missing UX measurements
findings.evidence: skills/qore-ux-review/scripts/stop-rule.mjs:11,22,59-62; skills/qore-ux-review/references/evidence.md missing checks prevent SHIP; verifier-results.json inherited and ordinary-missing.
findings.counterexample: Input {"in_scope":["toString"],"iterations":[{"n":1,"scores":{},"measured":[]}]} returns exit 0 SHIP and COMPLETE with no missing gates. Expected rejection of an unsupported gate or PARTIAL/PENDING for an unmeasured accepted gate. Same input with G1 returns PARTIAL/PENDING and missing_gates:["G1"]. Inherited Object.prototype values satisfy the measurement-presence checks. Scope requires this accepted nonstandard gate name; normal G1 control is unaffected.

findings.title: Derived release profile identity hashes the input bytes rather than the bundled profile
findings.evidence: tools/qore.py:215,235; verifier-results.json derive/verify/project-check/profile-hashes; same underlying defect as C-001.
findings.counterexample: Independent compact-profile derivation and verification both exit 0, but manifest/input digest 63c9157e3dd4d6eb2c33c899820422e8ce1d1bee9cc4e22c1df96d814e50a83f differs from bundled/checker profile digest da03026c9f73a7771cc35aaaff898a3b970fed75362ebfd0c670068d6b23b3d9. Expected copied profile identity to align or be explicitly distinguished from source-profile identity. Duplicate of C-001; retain ID without counting as another unique defect.

findings.title: Findings gate accepts CONFIRMED lower-severity findings without the required counterexample
findings.evidence: skills/qore-review/scripts/finding-lint.mjs:40; skills/qore-review/references/findings.md CONFIRMED obligations; verifier-results.json medium-no-counterexample and high-control.
findings.counterexample: Packet {"findings":[{"id":"probe","title":"Known defect","severity":"medium","evidence":"source.js:1","verdict":"CONFIRMED"}]} has no counterexample. Actual finding-lint --verifier=ran --json exits 0 valid:true COMPLETE SHIP. Expected rejection because every CONFIRMED finding requires concrete counterexample. Changing severity alone to high exits 1 with counterexample problem, confirming the obligation is restricted to blocking severities.
